notes: Published title '@#$% Happens  Sorry About Ya' is a masked expletive, so the page is titled Jason Comstock DS; the published title stays in the source citation.
Posted 9 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
The post says the deck went 3-0 and won an unnamed local tournament (wins by 26, 23 and 15); no event is named, so it stays a general deck.

The post has no starting section. Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (posted 'Hunt Down OBJ') is the objective and Start Your Engines! (posted 'Start Your Engines (SI)') the starting interrupt; Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber and Visage Of The Emperor are the cards the objective deploys ('(SL)'/'(OBJ)' tags). All count toward the 60.

The first line '6 Attack Run' (before the 'Epic Events and Objecitve' header) is left out: Attack Run is a Light Side Epic Event and cannot be in a Dark deck, and the rest of the list adds up to 60 without it.
Visage Of The Emperor is posted as 7 copies although the card is unique; kept as published (the strategy says 'Quanity will not be reduced. The Multiple 7's are way to valuable').

Posted 'Mara Jade, The Emperor's' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' the Reflections II combo Ommni Box & It's Worse (the card's spelling); 'Watto's Box (SE)' the Tatooine Effect Watto's Box (no other printing exists).
Posted 'Tatooine Cantina', 'Tat Podrace Arena' and 'Boonta Eve Podrace' dested the Dark printings; 'Darth Vader' and 'Grand Moff Tarkin' the Premiere cards.
The strategy mentions Aurra Sing, who is not in the posted list.
Secret Plans was an Effect in 2001.
The section headers ('Epic Events and Objecitve', 'Weapons/Devices and Podracers') are not cards.
Total is 60 as published (without the '6 Attack Run' line).
